brand_identity.name: SOJARU
brand_identity.positioning: Modern Headless Lifestyle Store for You & Your Pet
brand_identity.archetype: Organic & Playful Premium (Swiss Grid meets Warm Contemporary Lifestyle)
brand_identity.vibe: Curated, joyful, warm, accessible luxury, pet-first storytelling

theme.description: Warm bone/sand background (#FAFAF7) with deep obsidian typography (#121212), vibrant playful pops of terracotta rust (#E05A47), matcha green (#4A6B53), and buttery oat (#F4EFE6).

fonts.headline: Cabinet Grotesk / Outfit / Playfair Display (editorial dynamic blend)

scale.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.08]

component_guidelines.header_nav: Sticky glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 border-b border-black/5 z-50). Mega-menus for 'FOR YOU' and 'FOR YOUR PET' with visual subcategory previews.
component_guidelines.hero_section: Asymmetric visual layout. Headline on left with dual CTAs ('Shop Now', 'Shop For Your Pet'). Right side features pill-framed lifestyle photography and interactive hover badge.
component_guidelines.two_shopping_worlds: Side-by-side hero-level dual cards for 'FOR YOU' and 'FOR YOUR PET'. Subtle zoom effect on hover, distinctive background tinting, clear subcategory pills.
component_guidelines.product_card: Minimalist rectangular product cards with 1px border (#E5E5E0). Image aspect-ratio 4:5 with secondary image reveal on hover. Pill sale/new badges, variant quick-swatch dots, wishlist button, and quick add-to-cart drawer trigger.
component_guidelines.cart_drawer: Slide-over drawer with free shipping progress bar, item list with quantity steppers, cross-sell recommendation carousel ('Add a matching Pet Tag'), subtotal, tax estimation, and checkout button.
component_guidelines.pdp_product_detail: 2-column layout: Sticky media gallery grid on left, sticky product info on right. Swatches for size/color, pet-size guide trigger, expandable accordion tabs (Details, Shipping, Materials), customer review stars + pet photos.
component_guidelines.account_dashboard: Clean tabbed sidebar (Orders, Addresses, Saved Pets Profiles, Account Details, Wishlist). Responsive table view for order status with tracking link modal.

motion_and_interactions.hover_buttons: transition-all duration-200 ease-out hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md active:translate-y-0
motion_and_interactions.toast_notifications: Use Sonner for slide-in toast notifications upon Add to Cart and Wishlist actions.
motion_and_interactions.drawer_transition: Smooth framer-motion or CSS slide-in from right

data_testing_rules.rule: ALL interactive buttons, inputs, links, cards, tabs, select boxes MUST have descriptive kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow this document strictly. Do NOT use default plain WooCommerce tables or generic templates.
Implement the two core shopping worlds 'FOR YOU' and 'FOR YOUR PET' with prominent visual distinction throughout the user journey.
Subcategories for 'FOR YOU': Clothing, Drinkware, Caps, Stationery, Accessories, Bags, Gifting.
Subcategories for 'FOR YOUR PET': Pet Tags, Unisex Dog Shirts.
Ensure seamless state management for Cart Drawer, Quick View, Search modal, and Filter/Sort on Category pages.
Include mock data rich with products for both humans and pets (e.g. 'Matchy-Matchy Human & Dog Hoodie Set', 'Sojaru Stainless Pet Water Bottle', 'Handcrafted Brass Pet Tag').
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
